title: 1638 Prairie's door gets the transom its photograph shows
items: The pale gabled shape over the Shortall-Gregory house's double door turns out to be a glass transom, so the door now has one: a bar over the leaves and a single light under a low gable.

The photograph's long run of front steps was worked out too: the floor stands about 1.4 m up on the house's basement, and the photographer stood on the far sidewalk. Rebuilding the house to that is the next ticket.
